title: Calibrated cross-experiment reported-pain inference from complete laser-evoked EEG epochs
scientific_question: After two labeled calibration trials from a new person, can a general model infer the person's subsequent reported pain intensity from an EEG epoch, beyond laser energy and experimental context, when the entire experiment is held out?

estimand.primary: Expected absolute error in the recorded 0–10 pain-intensity report, averaged over all eligible post-calibration trials within each person, then all persons within each of nine experiments, then equally across all nine experiments.
estimand.target_is: The recorded subjective intensity response, including decimal responses; it is neither objective pain nor a clinical diagnosis. Pain unpleasantness is a different field and is never substituted.
estimand.interpretation: An offline processed-epoch recognition assay with fixed two-trial person calibration and leave-one-experiment-out development. It does not identify a causal nociceptive mechanism or prove neural specificity.
estimand.unit: A trial is a nested observation. A participant-within-experiment is the nominal biological unit; cross-experiment participant reuse must be reconciled before biological independence is claimed.
estimand.no_task_multiplication: Nine outer folds, source experiments, control conditions, modality variants, three agent modes and uncertainty outputs are one assay.

paper.title: A comprehensive EEG dataset of laser-evoked potentials for pain research
paper.role: Published collection design and intended no-intervention population; not an already scored prediction benchmark.

official_code.commit_role: Complete git-ref response names this immutable commit. The recursive tree response also reported this sha; independent root-tree reconstruction is not replaced by that response field.
official_code.license: No code license file in the complete 27-entry tree; GitHub repository metadata license is null. No reuse/redistribution permission is inferred from public visibility.

sources.pinned_metadata: The inspected evidence comprises publisher descriptions, README files and seven official code bodies. Only source identities and authored scientific interpretation are published here. Official code bodies, raw HTTP originals and failed partial responses are excluded; no code reuse or redistribution permission is inferred.
sources.identity_limit: Published version labels are mutable references. Body hashes, observed IDs and exact blob joins freeze the inspected evidence; tag→commit→computed tree binding and actual data-object hashes remain intake gates.

full_population.coverage: All nine named experiments and every declared subject directory. Use all original pre-intervention or non-intervention nociceptive laser trials satisfying predeclared measurement-validity rules. Two calibration trials are reserved per person; every other eligible trial is assessed. No favorable subject, device, intensity, channel, block or outcome selection.
full_population.acquisition: BioSemi, ANT and Brain Products systems differ in montage, reference and rate. Preserve the complete recorded EEG montage after explicit EEG/EOG channel typing; no common-channel intersection silently discards recorded EEG.
full_population.raw_scope_warning: The raw and session-merged releases also include other interventions or sensory conditions. Being in the raw collection does not itself make a trial eligible. Exact trial-level condition extraction must be established from original per-experiment preprocessing/event sources before any packet is admitted.
full_population.trial_count: Not yet measured. Paper/README planned trials differ in places; never multiply nominal participant and planned-trial counts as an actual denominator.
important_source_ambiguities: Experiments 4 and 5 README files say all laser markers are delayed by 100 ms. Verify the sign and whether derivatives already correct this; never apply a correction twice.
Experiment 6 README describes 80 trials whereas the collection table describes six blocks of 12–14 trials; actual IDs and retained baseline trials require reconciliation.
Experiment 3 README permits decimal intensity and unpleasantness reports and reports missing age; preserve decimal intensity and do not infer missing age.
Experiment 9 README has no task detail beyond its citation. Use the paper plus original event/preprocessing sources; an empty README is not sufficient trial mapping.
Three README bodies and mat_generate.m contain non-UTF-8 bytes. Exact bytes and escaped views are retained; the encoding has not been guessed.
full_population.exclusions: Only declared non-laser/intervention trials, invalid original alignment, missing target, or predeclared source-QC rejection can be excluded before model outputs. Keep a complete source-to-trial ledger with reason and person/experiment denominators. A person with fewer than three valid trials or an unresolvable cohort holds the complete assay; it is not silently removed to report a nine-cohort score.

protected_split.outer: Nine folds, each holding out one complete experiment. Cross-study repeated-person identities, duplicates and derivative/raw aliases must be grouped and purged together. If unique-person linkage cannot be established, report experiment transfer only and withhold an independent-person generalization claim.
protected_split.authoring: For each outer fold start fresh A/B/C authoring contexts, filesystem and caches. They receive the same common scientific documentation and the same eight training support examples, one per other experiment. No held-out experiment labels or private metrics may enter authoring.
protected_split.support_selection: For each of the eight training experiments select one valid trial by a predeclared SHA-256 ordering over salted canonical person/trial IDs, without inspecting target values or EEG quality beyond declared validity. Freeze support IDs once for the outer fold. The owner has not materialized these IDs.
protected_split.calibration: For every target person, reserve exactly their first two chronologically eligible baseline trials as labeled calibration, including actual energy/context and complete common EEG representation. These two trials are never scored. Every remaining trial is a fresh isolated query with the same two calibration examples.
protected_split.heldout_state: No scored-trial labels, participant mean rating, future outcomes, all-test prediction summaries or cross-query persistent memory. B's submitted program is frozen before query exposure and receives only the same ten support/calibration cases plus the current query. All candidate-derived state is destroyed after each query; fixed source program is the only reusable candidate artifact.
protected_split.tuning: A/B/C prompt/code choices, representation and budgets are frozen using training-side information before outer test. Cross-fold feedback is owner-only; a later fold cannot inherit earlier test labels or optimization results.
protected_split.development_status: All source data and reports are public historical development data. Fresh contexts do not undo pretraining exposure. A future untouched external acquisition is needed for a strong contamination-resistant claim.

common_packet.input: One complete 3-second source-defined EEG epoch per query and per support/calibration example; full eligible EEG channel roster, coordinates/labels, timestamps, units, actual delivered laser energy if present, stimulated side, device/reference metadata, and source-declared rating protocol. Opaque random IDs replace source subject/session/trial names.
common_packet.represented_signal: Proposed common 30-Hz-bandlimited, 100-Hz time grid covering the complete [-1,+2]-second epoch. This is an explicitly information-reduced representation, not untouched raw EEG. Use all measured EEG channels and all grid samples. Freeze a mathematically specified antialias/resampling implementation after clock/source review, with deterministic round-trip/error evidence before results.
common_packet.values: Serialize physical microvolt values to fixed 0.01 µV integers plus a scale field. Do not clip, discard extremes, normalize using target labels, average across query trials or substitute peaks. Report quantization residuals and any unrepresentable/missing values. Missing channels retain their masks; no interpolation to fabricate channels.
common_packet.context_feasibility: The exact ten examples plus query and documentation must fit a 1,048,576-token live context with the chosen tokenizer. Per-query cumulative model input allowance is 3,145,728 tokens, cumulative generated output16,384 tokens; both A and C receive these same ceilings. All C model/tool interaction counts, repeated context and failed calls are included. The three-times-live input cap allows bounded rereading, not extra cases or data. Check the largest complete packet and actual protocol before scientific execution. If it does not fit, this version refuses: no channel/time/support truncation, favorable case selection or silent replacement by summary features.
common_packet.optional_rendering: An optional fixed full-channel waveform rendering may accompany the numerical packet only if its complete numerical operand is identical in all three modes. Rendering adds no hidden feature or label; any image token cost is included in the same cap.
common_packet.representation_baseline: Assess original full-precision source epochs and the exact common representation with the same reference predictor as separate information conditions. Preserve every discrepancy; report that native-mode claims apply only to the frozen representation.
common_packet.source_preprocessing_limit: Released manual artifact rejection/ICA/rereferencing may use a participant's whole session. Inherited processing is therefore offline and potentially transductive in unlabeled neural values. It is not an online causal decoder, nor fully train-only preprocessing. Full source-level timing/ICA lineage is an admission gate.
denied: EEG.event/EEG.epoch fields containing answers or calibrated rating categories
Published rating-sorted or power-sorted ERP MAT summaries
Per-person mean outcomes or per-trial target-derived artifact flags
Source filenames, absolute event codes and publication subject IDs that permit lookup
Any other held-out query or future response
Network or repository lookup during assessment
common_packet.calibrated_intensity_caveat: A source condition named '7/10' is a calibration target, not delivered Joules and not the current trial answer. Actual delivered energy and documented calibration-category context are separate fields. Provide identical context to all modes and to the energy-only baseline; never infer energy from a target rating. Missing actual energy holds claims about incremental information beyond physical intensity.
common_packet.timing_caveat: End-of-epoch must be joined to actual report onset and source marker corrections. If a future source audit cannot exclude response motor activity, label the assay accordingly and withhold pre-report neural-specific interpretation; do not silently shorten the window after seeing outcomes.

agent_modes.A: Direct no-tool model predicts from the entire common packet in a fresh context.
agent_modes.B: A model authors one frozen prediction program per outer fold using the same eight training examples and documentation. Each isolated program call receives exactly the common calibration/query packet, may fit only its ten labeled examples, and emits the required prediction. No hidden source training bank.
agent_modes.C: A fresh case-adaptive model receives the identical packet and may call local Python/numerical tools to investigate it. No additional data or pretrained task-specific decoder is available in this primary comparison.
agent_modes.evidence_matching: Same packet bytes, labels, support budget, preprocessing, source documentation and protected cases across A/B/C. Differences are computational interaction and program reuse, not a larger labeled corpus.
agent_modes.trained_model_tools: A future full-training decoder-as-tool condition must be a separately versioned information condition, with its training provenance and pretraining exposure disclosed. It cannot replace C while retaining the primary equal-evidence claim.
agent_modes.fixed_execution_proposal: Per-query B/C local numerical work: one CPU, 2 GiB memory,120 seconds cumulative including children; C at most32 tool calls. A/C each have the same1,048,576-token live context,3,145,728-token cumulative input and16,384-token cumulative generated output caps. B authoring per outer fold has those same ceilings once; runtime calls receive no new LLM assistance. These are prospective limits, not measured capacity. Report actual costs separately: this compares modes under common evidence and explicit ceilings, not identical physical compute.

predictions_and_scoring.schema: For every required opaque query ID output one finite predicted median rating in [0,10]. Optional 10th/90th quantiles must satisfy 0<=q10<=median<=q90<=10. No integer rounding is required.
predictions_and_scoring.primary_formula: MAE_e = mean_p(mean_t |median_ept - rating_ept|); primary MAE = (1/9) sum_e MAE_e. All post-calibration eligible trials remain in each person denominator. Also report participant-weighted 678-person aggregate, all nine experiment results and device strata without promoting them to separate benchmarks.
predictions_and_scoring.missing_invalid: Assign loss10 to each absent, duplicate, malformed, nonfinite or out-of-range required prediction. Do not drop abstentions or use only successfully parsed trials. An unavailable source target is an intake defect resolved before scoring, not candidate abstention.
predictions_and_scoring.incremental_neural_information: Report paired person/experiment MAE difference against the fixed energy/context-only baseline under exactly the same supports. Better raw MAE alone does not show incremental EEG value. Preserve the energy baseline even if it is strong.
predictions_and_scoring.uncertainty: Report paired within-experiment participant cluster bootstrap intervals and an experiment-macro summary, with all nine experiment effects shown. Nine experiments are heterogeneous convenience cohorts; bootstrap uncertainty is conditional and not a universal population guarantee. Reused-person grouping is required before bootstrap.
secondary: Within-person rank correlation on all assessed trials, with undefined/constant cases kept and denominators disclosed
Continuous 80% interval coverage and width when valid quantiles are supplied
Training-mean-normalized absolute error only as a secondary metric with frozen training denominators
predictions_and_scoring.scorer_checks: Future scorer must reject answer-bearing paths, nonfinite/out-of-domain outputs, altered IDs, duplicate/missing records, leakage via hidden source metadata, cross-case persistent state, and incompatible source/representation versions. Controls exercise the actual evaluator; no scorer has been implemented or run.

competent_references.name: Support median
competent_references.method: Predicted rating is their median; target-person calibration median reported separately. No EEG or test target access.

competent_references.name: Energy/context regression
competent_references.information: Same ten examples and delivered-energy/context fields
competent_references.method: OLS/ridge on predeclared energy, side and observed calibration-category features, with a fixed lambda=1 after centering/scaling from the ten supplied examples only. Unknown categories use a documented missing indicator. No tuning on additional source people; full-training tuned reference is separate.

competent_references.name: Waveform nearest support
competent_references.method: A declared channel/coordinate-aware distance with masks and train-only scale. No label-sorted time alignment; all-channel error and missing-channel policy fixed before test.

competent_references.name: Physiology-informed ridge
competent_references.method: Predeclared signed channelwise mean amplitudes in 150–350 ms and 250–600 ms relative to corrected stimulus onset, plus pre-stimulus variance, standardized using the ten examples only; fixed lambda=1 ridge. These windows and lambda are benchmark design choices, not an asserted official predictor or an observed optimum. All-channel missing-mask handling and exact denominator behavior require implementation review.

competent_references.name: Full-training EEG reference
competent_references.information: All eligible training people from the eight non-test experiments plus identical two-trial target calibration
competent_references.method: Competent train-only EEG regression with nested experiment/participant tuning and a matching full-training energy/context baseline. This is a deliberately larger-information reference, reported separately; it does not win the primary A/B/C comparison by assertion.

scientific_controls: Use context-only, neural-only and joint inputs under declared variants to measure the contribution of delivered energy and protocol.
Use actual baseline interval and event-shift controls with exact same support/units/scorer; treat them as controls, not independent biological datasets.
Preserve a montage-label permutation diagnostic and a physical-unit scaling check without reclassifying distorted inputs as new experimental observations.
Counterfactual removal of EEG must be compared on exactly the same participant/trial denominator and source conditions.
Do not claim mechanistic nociceptive specificity from N2/P2 prediction; salience, attention and report preparation remain plausible explanations.
Predeclare hypotheses and assess paired errors, not subjective chain-of-thought quality; explanations can be audited for factual consistency but cannot replace numerical held-out evaluation.
source_code_findings: power_screen.m selects by EEG.event.laser_power; rating_screen.m selects by EEG.event.rating. These are target/covariate-conditioned selection utilities and are not prediction pipelines.
mat_generate.m averages EEG.data across its third dimension before extracting a channel. Published ERP summaries therefore cannot serve as trial-level neural inputs.

The complete Supplement-Data repository exposes mat_generate.m, while mat_creation.m calls mat_generate2. That helper is absent from this pinned repository; this observation makes no claim about unseen external workspaces or uninspected OpenNeuro preprocessing sources.

file_select.m's active power section calls rating_screen on the 29ByANT path, unlike its surrounding commented power_screen examples. Preserve this literal source behavior and do not treat it as a verified author analysis path.
Published examples group ratings1–10 and selected energies; the benchmark retains actual rating0 and decimal values and the full declared baseline population.

resource_and_storage.current_operation: Source-only metadata and contract construction; no EEG, behavior/participant table, MAT/SET/FDT, event trial body, array, native package, model, scorer or training execution.
resource_and_storage.authentic_storage_reason: Complete data-file sizes and checksums have not been measured. Five recursive metadata inventories are complete; the other four have complete top-level metadata only. The oversized ds005293 partial response is explicitly incomplete and retained. No GB estimate is substituted for an exact acquisition manifest.
resource_and_storage.whole_future_intake: Acquire/verify a complete immutable object manifest for all nine releases, exact subject/session/raw/derivative links and complete selected baseline epochs; reconcile source chronology, targets and QC before authorizing full input preparation. No sample-only packet qualifies the full assay.
resource_and_storage.prospective_execution_estimate: Numerical reference likely requires workstation-class EEG preprocessing and regression, but wall time, peak memory, full storage and model context costs remain unmeasured. Estimate them from complete manifests and an implemented exact workload before allocation.
resource_and_storage.complete_campaign: Total assessed cases are unknown until complete trial census. Required calls = three modes times all assessed cases plus declared controls/references; count every failed attempt. Do not infer affordability from per-case caps or launch a paid campaign.

admission_gates: This source-backed contract has undergone independent scientific review and registration. Authentic intake, executable transformations, reference evaluation and protected model comparison remain separate admission gates.
Resolve immutable source commit/tree/version and all-data object sizes/checksums; complete nine-cohort trial and lineage census.
Reconcile cross-experiment participant identity, original baseline-condition extraction, manual-QC provenance and both 100-ms marker shifts.
Verify delivered energy versus calibrated rating categories and exact intensity-versus-unpleasantness target fields for every cohort.
Authenticate full EEG/target chronology, native units, all recorded channels, preprocessing/ICA and source sampling clocks.
Specify and review the full deterministic 30-Hz/100-Hz transformation; preserve full source operands and quantify representation loss.
Demonstrate the largest complete ten-support-plus-query packet fits the frozen context without trimming, using the selected tokenizer/model.
Resolve permission to use/distribute official code or independently implement documented transformations under an appropriate license; CC0 data does not license code.
Implement exact baselines, scorer, protected delivery and cleanup, and independently verify authentic whole-cohort references and control outcomes.
Freeze a real evaluation protocol and campaign budget before model execution; scientific/Terminal-Bench readiness remains false.

deduplication.scope: The complete original 200 registry plus the earlier accepted additions and held reserves were examined. The two additions were also checked against the later bilateral-PFC and OFC source identities before registration.
deduplication.result: None of the nine OpenNeuro IDs, this paper DOI or official Supplement-Data repository occurs in the inspected registered/reserve sources. Existing reward/emotion ERP, clinical seizures, sleep, visual/motor EEG and Helsinki neonatal EEG target distinct sources and estimands.
deduplication.caveat: A URL mismatch alone is not biological independence. Actual participant reuse across the nine source studies and any public pretraining overlap remain unresolved.

publication_note: Public design document, not a candidate input packet. Source facts are distinguished from prospective benchmark choices. Registration does not establish authentic-input coverage, an executable reference, protected scoring, agent performance or scientific qualification.
